CustomField.description: ECMv2.1 field used by ECM in the creating the Placement sequence. Best practice is to keep this field as short as possible and to not include semi-colons (';'). In addition, the field should always be based in part off of Job_Type__c for compatibility with the ECM Placement trigger logic. Original ECM field. Restore for unit test to pass: TEXT(Job_Type__c)
